start_urls_note: The single /archive/ page lists every issue page the WordPress site publishes (24 issue pages, vol 48 iss 4 through vol 54 iss 3) plus 178 outbound links to the Digital Commons backfile. It is NOT paginated - there is no pager, no ?page=N, and no /page/N/; one fetch yields the complete issue list.

metadata.status_reason: CORRECTED 2026-08-29. The prior seed claimed the WP shell had 'no PDFs' and rerouted everything to bepress. That is wrong: hofstralawreview.org/archive/volume-*/ pages link 195 PDFs directly under /wp-content/uploads/, and those download fine (3/3 smoke tests, 190KB-605KB, valid %PDF). The bepress backfile is the correct source for vol 1-47, but /cgi/viewcontent.cgi is currently Cloudflare-403 platform-wide, so the WordPress host is the only presently retrievable source.

backfile.status: enumeration OK, retrieval blocked - /cgi/viewcontent.cgi returns Cloudflare HTTP 403 across all bepress hosts (see ACQUISITION_BACKLOG_2026-08-29.md). Covered by seeds scholarlycommons-law-hofstra-edu.json and hofstra_law_review.json.

navigation.notes:
PDF hrefs are emitted as http:// (not https://) but the host redirects and serves them fine. Article author names are bare text nodes after a
inside the same

as the title link, so there is no author element to select - the adapter must split the paragraph text. hofstralawreview.org robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/ and /wp-content/uploads/bulk-media-register-tmp/; no Crawl-delay. The WP REST API is closed (401 rest_login_required), so use /archive/ or wp-sitemap.xml, not wp-json. No second journal is published on this host: wp-sitemap-posts-page-1.xml lists 45 pages, all Hofstra Law Review; the second registry row for this host (registry_hofstra_law_review_1885_c2108637c0.json, www.hofstralawreview.org) is a duplicate of the same journal, not a distinct publication. Hofstra's other journals live on separate hosts (hofstralelj.org, hofstrajibl.org, scholarlycommons.law.hofstra.edu/hlelj/, /jibl/).
